FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Blinds & Window Treatments specializes in the retail of custom window treatments, including blinds, shades, and drapery for residential and light commercial clients. Our operations focus on quality craftsmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring that all projects meet industry safety standards. We maintain strong relationships with reputable manufacturers, which allows us to offer an extensive range of high-quality products. While we provide basic integration with home automation systems, any electrical work is strictly handled by certified electricians to mitigate risk. Our customer management system enhances operational efficiency, and we prioritize regular training for our staff to keep up to date with techniques and safety protocols.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred during the handling of window treatments resulted in damaged merchandise amounting to $1,200. The incident occurred on 05/15/2023 and the claim is currently being processed.
FIELDS.ADDRESS: 4567 Window Treatment Ave, Suite 200, Springfield, IL 62704-6789
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9 AM - 6 PM, Saturday: 10 AM - 4 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class A, Grade 1, Secured by keyless entry and monitored alarm system.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Installation of security fencing around premises to enhance safety of materials and protect against theft or damage.
